shared_identity.string_normalization: Unicode NFKC, then Unicode NFC, trim leading/trailing whitespace, collapse each consecutive whitespace run to one ASCII space, casefold
shared_identity.source_tuple_encoding: UTF-8 JSON array with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true where objects occur, separators=(',', ':'), no trailing newline
shared_identity.record_id: extb_rec_v1_<sha256(record_domain + NUL + family_id + NUL + condition_id + NUL + record_role)>

selection_and_split_order.candidate_order: ascending SHA-256 of PA-EXT-B-V1-ORDER + NUL + canonical_source_tuple; canonical_source_tuple is the tie-break
selection_and_split_order.selection: retain the first 220 eligible unique families per task after canonical deduplication
selection_and_split_order.family_ordinal: zero-based position in the selected ordered list
selection_and_split_order.condition_blocks: family_ordinal // 22 selects c01 through c10 in listed order

spatial.source_row_ordinal: zero-based physical JSONL line number in the frozen train.jsonl
spatial.relation_normalization: apply shared string normalization; accept only the listed labels
spatial.argument_orientation: ARG_A is the first synthetic canonical argument and ARG_B the second; the StepGame label is interpreted as ARG_A relative to ARG_B
spatial.argument_labels: extb_spatial_arg_a_<zero_padded_source_row_ordinal> and extb_spatial_arg_b_<zero_padded_source_row_ordinal>; generated identifiers, not story/question text
spatial.eligibility: valid JSON object, allowed label, and no duplicate canonical source tuple

quantitative.source_identity: prospective deterministic programmatic source; no external text source
quantitative.numeric_domain: A in [11,32], B in [-17,4]; zero and negative B are allowed
quantitative.equality: excluded by construction; equality is not an eligible source relation
quantitative.duplicate_numeric_pair: not duplicated within a task; condition/split identity remains part of family identity
quantitative.canonical_numeric_format: base-10 ASCII digits, minus sign only for negative values, no plus sign, no leading zero, no -0
quantitative.ordering: shared condition-block order followed by within_condition_index ascending; no outcome-dependent ordering

mereological.pointer_direction: meronym pointers are whole->part and holonym pointers are part->whole; normalize both to ARG_A=part/member/substance and ARG_B=whole
mereological.lemma_normalization: shared string normalization; retain only non-empty lemma strings
mereological.synset_selection: noun synsets with at least one allowed pointer; choose the lexicographically first valid lemma for each normalized endpoint
mereological.ambiguity: retain all distinct valid pointer edges; do not manually prefer a sense
mereological.selection: shared first-220 hash order after eligibility and deduplication
